kyoto_kamesuehiro.gf_detail: Ask. Dry sweets (rakugan of rice flour and brown rice), fresh sweets and yokan, and a senbei-manju of mochi wafer; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kamesuehiro.vegan_detail: Ask. Bean-paste and sugar sweets are likely candidates, but no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kamesuehiro.hours_raw: 9:00–17:00, Mon, Tue and Thu–Sat; closed Wednesday, Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Takeaway only (Tabelog). Fresh sweets keep only to the day, the senbei-manju to the next day (August–September 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). On Aneyakoji-dori, 3 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kamesuehiro.notes: [Wagashi · Karasuma-Oike, a confectioner since 1804] Behind an old shopfront near the Shinpukan, a quiet, old-fashioned shop where the staff explain each sweet in a soft Kyoto lilt. It is known for refined dry sweets — the seasonal boxed assortment and delicate rakugan — and for fresh sweets that must be eaten the same day; the senbei-manju (¥300), crisp mochi wafers filled with bean paste as you buy, is the local favourite. Takeaway only; cash only; closed Wednesdays, Sundays and holidays. A September 2026 buyer found the wrapping and handling careless.

roles: Family-run confectioner, said to be in its seventh generation (August 2026 review); no names in a source
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: founded in 1804 and said to be run by the seventh generation; dry sweets, fresh sweets and yokan. Listed by the Kyoto meibutsu association 京名物百味会 (its shop page). Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018–2020, 2022 and Japanese sweets WEST 2023, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Boxed dry sweets; senbei-manju; fresh sweets.

anecdotes.text: "When I bought it, they filled the red bean paste on the spot for takeout." — August 2026, the senbei-manju.
"As I looked at the array of wagashi, the staff kindly explained each sweet in detail." — September 2026.
"The cashier carelessly dropped the tray on top of the product samples, which felt rather sloppy." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 京名物百味会のページ (kyomeibutuhyakumikai.jp)。食べログ: 亀末廣、和菓子、中京区姉小路車屋町東入ル車屋町251、烏丸御池駅から徒歩約3分、月・火・木〜土 9:00〜17:00、水・日・祝休み、持ち帰りのみ、予約可、カード不可、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018〜2020・2022、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 1804年創業、7代目、干菓子、落雁、生菓子、その場で餡を詰める煎餅饅頭、丁寧な説明、包装や扱いが雑だったという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the sweets; staff explain each one.

kyoto_sushi_matsumoto_gion.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Edomae sushi with seasoned toppings and sauces (nikiri, tsume for anago and clams); nigiri come with salt and sudachi or soy sauce (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_matsumoto_gion.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:00) and dinner 18:00–21:00 (last order 19:00) on Mon and Thu–Sun; Wednesday is listed with no times; closed Tuesday and occasionally (Tabelog). Because Wednesday has no published times, no hours are stored. Reservations accepted, by phone or Ikyu (Tabelog; December 2025); no strong perfume or fabric softener (Tabelog). Omakase only (September 2026); a 17-piece lunch course (July 2026). 11 seats: a counter of 7 and two tables for 2 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; smoking in the courtyard (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). On the Yayoi-koji lane on the south side of Gion, 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 2006 (May 2026 review).
kyoto_sushi_matsumoto_gion.notes: [Sushi · Gion, Kyoto's Edomae counter] Through an indigo noren on the Yayoi-koji lane, a white-wood counter of seven where Daiten Matsumoto, from Kanagawa and trained at Tokyo's Shinbashi Shimizu, makes true Edomae sushi: red-vinegar rice with no sugar, kombu-cured sea bream, kohada, simmered Kuwana clams, anago with tsume, served briskly piece by piece. 2026 reviewers call it Michelin-starred and good value, with more locals than tourists. Omakase only; book by phone or Ikyu; no strong perfume. About ¥20,000–30,000.

chef_bio.chef_name: Daiten Matsumoto (May and September 2026 reviews; no given-name kanji in a source)
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: from Kanagawa; trained at Shinbashi Shimizu in Tokyo, a first disciple per one July 2026 review; opened Sushi Matsumoto in Gion in 2006; Michelin one star. Tabelog Sushi WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022, 2025.

anecdotes.text: "The rice is made without sugar, using only red vinegar and salt, resulting in a fluffy and slightly softer texture" — October 2026.
"In fact, it seems like there are more local customers compared to other restaurants." — August 2026.
"After visiting almost all the sushi restaurants in Kyoto, I finally returned to this place, my last stronghold." — October 2026.
